description: Android activity class for WiFi Direct (P2P) device discovery and connection management, including permission handling, broadcast receiver registration, and user interface interactions.

classes.name: WiFiDirectActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing WiFi Direct device discovery, connection, and user interactions.

methods.name: setIsWifiP2pEnabled
methods.description: Setter for WiFi P2P enabled state.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests, specifically for location access.

methods.name: initP2p
methods.description: Initializes WiFi P2P capabilities and checks device support.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity, including UI and WiFi P2P initialization.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers broadcast receiver for WiFi P2P events.

methods.name: resetData
methods.description: Clears peer list and device details UI.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu options for WiFi Direct controls.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions for enabling WiFi Direct and discovering peers.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays details of selected WiFi device.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a specified WiFi device.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from current WiFi P2P group.

methods.name: onChannelDisconnected
methods.description: Handles loss of WiFi P2P channel and attempts reinitialization.

methods.name: cancelDisconnect
methods.description: Cancels ongoing connection or disconnects if connected.
